scope: Scientific-topic and potential quantitative-component review of all 1,451 ScholarQA-Bio stems. Every complete literature-synthesis endpoint remains a gap; no authored question card or prospective full-coverage assignment.

exact_duplicate_audit.limit: Text uniqueness is not scientific endpoint uniqueness. Near-duplicates and overlapping requests are not automatically aliases.

routes.candidate_question: How do observed release, exposure or stability measurements change across a declared formulation, time or condition comparison?
routes.real_inputs: Independent observed release or concentration-time series, formulation/animal identifiers, units, detection limits and sampling metadata. Stability measurements and pharmacokinetic concentrations remain different endpoints.
routes.acceptance: Use a declared mass-balance or kinetic model where justified, retain all replicates, document time windows and fit failures, and compare full tables with a private input-reading oracle.
routes.limit: This exercises a quantitative component only. It does not answer broad claims about optimal delivery, mechanism, clinical translation or which experimental method should be chosen.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which assay measurements remain reliable after calibration, control subtraction and replicate-level uncertainty checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent native plate-reader, spectrum, sensor trace, image or chromatography records with standards, blanks, reference values and technical/biological replicate metadata.
routes.acceptance: Fit the declared calibration only on standards, preserve censoring and dilution factors, propagate declared uncertainty and report all samples. Instrument-specific parsing and transformations must be fixed before task assignment.
routes.limit: A calibration task cannot establish which method is best, list all available techniques or demonstrate clinical suitability. Source questions about method catalogs retain their narrative objective.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: What comparisons are supported by independently observed outcomes after harmonizing endpoints, groups and follow-up?
routes.real_inputs: Independent observed study tables or permitted participant records with comparator, timing, uncertainty, cohort identities and adjustment information. Clinical, device and preclinical outcomes cannot be pooled by name alone.
routes.acceptance: Keep experimental units, paired data, censoring, effect scales and overlapping cohorts explicit. Only combine compatible estimates with a prespecified method; report non-combinable studies without forcing an overall winner.
routes.limit: Comparative numbers do not replace broad benefit/risk synthesis, a clinical recommendation, cost-effectiveness assessment or animal-to-human transportability. Freeze the narrower measured question explicitly.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed marker associations or discrimination estimates persist after comparator and sampling checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent measured marker/expression tables with tissue, condition, subject and assay identities, negative comparison populations and permitted covariates.
routes.acceptance: Use subjects as the replicate unit, preserve all tested markers and multiplicity, and use held-out labels for predictive claims. Only require prediction artifacts when prediction is part of the concrete task.
routes.limit: Observed differential expression or discrimination cannot establish universal tissue exclusivity, causal targeting, mechanism or a comprehensive literature inventory.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Do model predictions retain calibration and performance on an independent observed assay cohort?
routes.real_inputs: Independent real assay measurements, model predictions or runnable specified models, subject/scaffold identities and fixed train/evaluation roles within a single corpus task.
routes.acceptance: Separate evaluation labels from fitting and preprocessing, grade complete held-out predictions and metrics, and compare against a declared baseline using the same examples.
routes.limit: Measured predictive performance does not assess broad AI capability, pharmaceutical adoption, emerging trends or the validity of arbitrary generated data.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: How accurately can paired observed images be aligned under a declared transform and independent landmark evaluation?
routes.real_inputs: Independent paired microscopy or phantom images, acquisition axes/pixel sizes and manually measured or instrument-recorded landmarks with separate fit and check landmarks.
routes.acceptance: Check transform direction, units, handedness, landmark identity and held-out residuals with deterministic numerical tolerances. Inspect resampling and overlap boundaries; do not evaluate only the fitting landmarks.
routes.limit: A phantom/microscopy registration adaptation does not establish safe intraoperative guidance. No existing question card has yet been chosen for this component.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed production or selection differences remain after construct, library and assay accounting?
routes.real_inputs: Independent benign protein-purification measurements or sequencing-based binding-screen counts with complete construct identities, controls and measured replicate outcomes.
routes.acceptance: Separate yield, purity, activity and enrichment; preserve input-library denominators and replicate structure. Sequence abundance is not a binding-affinity constant.
routes.limit: These endpoints require distinct questions and inputs. Accounting alone does not reproduce antibody discovery or establish the advantages of one production technology.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.real_inputs: No complete deterministic adaptation has been established from the reviewed stem. Independent evidence and a faithful bounded question are required before authoring.
routes.acceptance: Retain an unresolved endpoint rather than assigning a citation match, arbitrary factual lookup or language-model judge as a substitute.
routes.limit: Questions include mechanisms, optimization strategies, method catalogs, current practice, policy, historical trends and wet-lab protocols. A related computation does not complete the requested synthesis.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed microbial composition or function differences persist across the declared cohort, time or intervention comparison?
routes.real_inputs: Independent real amplicon or shotgun reads/counts, sample/donor metadata, extraction controls and pinned taxonomy/function references. These modalities need separate native processing paths.
routes.acceptance: Preserve compositional denominators, sequencing depth, repeated subjects and covariates. Predeclare filtering and distance/model choices; verify complete output tables and appropriate restricted permutations or subject-level contrasts.
routes.limit: Relative abundance is not absolute biomass or measured metabolic flux. An association cannot establish the gut-brain mechanism, universal healthy composition, intervention efficacy or long-term consequences.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which proteins or modification sites differ in independent observed mass-spectrometry measurements after identification and quantification checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent native spectra or supported DIA exports with sequence database, decoys, modifications, sample design and observed standards where available.
routes.acceptance: Keep peptide/protein/site identities and false-discovery levels distinct. Audit ambiguous peptides, missingness and replicate normalization; score full tables with declared tolerances and a native input-reading oracle.
routes.limit: Quantification does not establish a modification mechanism, protein function or the superiority of a proteomics technology. Precomputed tables cannot claim raw-spectrum identification.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: What editing outcomes and specificity estimates are supported by an independently observed benign editing dataset?
routes.real_inputs: Existing observed read alignments or validated allele/site counts, reference assembly, assay coverage, controls and replicate labels; use benign independent systems without designing new interventions.
routes.acceptance: Preserve detection limits, eligible-site universe, coordinate/strand conventions and assay-specific ascertainment. Separate predicted off-target candidates from experimentally measured sites and distinguish unobserved from measured negative outcomes.
routes.limit: Counting outcomes does not establish an optimal guide, eliminate off-target risk, or validate a therapeutic strategy. Pathogen-specific source conclusions receive no credit from a benign-system adaptation.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: How do independently observed production or removal rates compare after mass, time and control accounting?
routes.real_inputs: Independent real fermentation, carbon-fixation or environmental-assay time series with reactor/sample identities, blank and abiotic controls, volumes, inflow/outflow and measured analytes.
routes.acceptance: Use declared units and concentration-to-mass conversions, preserve measured volumes and sampling losses, distinguish yield from productivity, and retain incomplete balances rather than inventing unmeasured fluxes.
routes.limit: Color loss does not prove degradation or detoxification; concentration decline may reflect adsorption or dilution. A bench assay cannot establish industrial scalability, life-cycle benefit or economic feasibility.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed material or printed-construct differences remain after geometry, calibration and replicate checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent observed stress/strain or rheology traces, swelling measurements, microscopy/print images, specimen dimensions and cell-viability measurements where relevant.
routes.acceptance: Predeclare geometry normalization, loading-rate/frequency conventions, segmentation and admissible fit regions. Preserve complete traces or image-derived feature ledgers; compare native outputs and parameter fits with explicit tolerances.
routes.limit: Mechanical stiffness, print fidelity and cell viability are different endpoints. One cannot substitute for another or establish clinical biocompatibility and tissue function.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed evoked responses or synaptic-current features differ between the declared conditions?
routes.real_inputs: Independent native NWB/ABF or documented electrophysiology recordings, stimulus/event times, calibration and animal/cell/session metadata.
routes.acceptance: Freeze baseline windows, units, filtering, artifact exclusions, latency/amplitude definitions and repeated-cell/session handling. Grade complete feature tables and hierarchical contrasts; distinguish current-clamp, voltage-clamp, spikes and field potentials.
routes.limit: A response contrast does not identify a molecular mechanism or establish learning, therapeutic efficacy or optimal stimulation settings.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed oscillatory events and timing relationships survive declared detection and control checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent observed neural recordings, spike/event timestamps, sleep/behavior annotations and sampling metadata with biological replicates.
routes.acceptance: Freeze frequency bands, detection thresholds and edge handling; preserve event durations and complete detections. Use declared shuffled/time-shift controls and animal/session-level uncertainty, with source-independent parameter selection.
routes.limit: Event correlation or replay detection does not prove a memory mechanism or creative cognition. Spike timing, field-potential power and phase coupling require separate definitions.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: How do observed learning curves, task performance or recovery trajectories differ after trial and subject accounting?
routes.real_inputs: Independent real trial logs, calibrated force/angle/motion measurements, task versions and animal/participant/session identities. Preserve unsuccessful trials and training-stage transitions.
routes.acceptance: Specify success criteria, denominators, censoring and excluded trials before analysis. Separate strength, dexterity, latency and accuracy; fit repeated-measures contrasts with subject-level replication and retain baseline differences.
routes.limit: Better task scores do not alone prove neural recovery, plasticity or transfer from animals to humans. Compensatory movements and changed task difficulty need their own measurement checks.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed image-derived anatomical or connectivity differences remain after acquisition and subject-level quality checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent real NIfTI/BIDS imaging or appropriate native microscopy with acquisition metadata, atlas/segmentation provenance, subject identifiers and fixed comparison groups.
routes.acceptance: Preserve affine orientation, voxel/physical units, subject-to-visit mapping, mask definitions and motion/confound regressors. Validate full ROI/feature outputs; functional correlation, anatomical structure and cellular morphometry remain distinct analyses.
routes.limit: An image metric is not a proven causal pathway, BBB safety measure or clinical diagnosis. Spine counts, MRI volume and functional connectivity cannot substitute for one another.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Does a specified neural-signal pipeline preserve held-out decoding performance after artifact and session-shift checks?
routes.real_inputs: Independent real neural recordings with observed annotated artifacts or documented auxiliary channels, event labels and subject/session identifiers. No synthetic noise-only fixture replaces real recording artifacts.
routes.acceptance: Separate subjects/sessions before preprocessing and fitting. Grade complete artifact/decoding outputs, retained-signal checks, event synchronization and fixed held-out metrics. Freeze labels and windows independently of predictions.
routes.limit: Offline decoding does not validate live closed-loop control or clinical rehabilitation. Running a substitute pipeline does not establish SANTIA-specific operation; preserve the required named package when claiming that component.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which network estimates or graph properties are supported by independent observed molecular evidence?
routes.real_inputs: Independent measured interactions or perturbation observations, explicit directed/typed node and edge identities, evidence provenance and an evaluation partition that prevents edge leakage.
routes.acceptance: Fix edge direction, signs, weights, duplicate handling and evaluation universe. Verify complete graph statistics and predictions against private observed evidence; report unmeasured edges as unknown.
routes.limit: Topological similarity or predictive association does not establish causal mechanism. A knowledge-graph entry cannot silently become an experimentally verified interaction.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: How do specified predicted poses or structural ensembles agree with independent experimental structural and binding evidence?
routes.real_inputs: Independent experimental PDB/mmCIF structures, benign ligand SDF records, measured assay metadata and specified predictions or bounded native docking runs; reconcile atom, chain and chemical states.
routes.acceptance: Use symmetry-aware atom matching, declared alignment and full candidate outputs; keep pose accuracy, docking score, measured affinity and simulation-derived kinetics separate. Report failed candidates and native runtime.
routes.limit: A docking score is not a binding constant, and a static pose cannot establish a binding pathway or kinetic rate. Preserve whether the task runs a tool or evaluates existing predictions.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which map, particle-class or model-to-map quality measurements are supported by independent observed cryo-EM data?
routes.real_inputs: Independent deposited MRC maps/half-maps, masks, particle metadata where required and experimental model coordinates with voxel/origin conventions.
routes.acceptance: Declare masks, half-map independence, Fourier-shell/coordinate conventions and native processing. Use complete diagnostic curves or particle-class assignments; verify units and all requested regions.
routes.limit: A final-map check does not exercise raw-movie correction or particle reconstruction. A headline resolution is not local structural certainty; no cross-method superiority claim follows from one dataset.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: What does a frozen structural archive contain after identifier, method and release reconciliation?
routes.real_inputs: Independent versioned archive metadata with accession histories, experimental methods, obsolete/replacement records and retrieval provenance.
routes.acceptance: Distinguish entries, assemblies, chains and distinct molecules. Preserve multiple methods per entry, missing fields, release cutoffs and archive-specific identifier mappings.
routes.limit: An archive audit does not answer historical impact, collaboration benefits or repository governance. Retrieval failures are not absent structures.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

routes.candidate_question: Which observed expression or epigenetic-feature relationships persist under the declared sample and assay model?
routes.real_inputs: Independent observed RNA, chromatin or methylation measurements with biological replicates, native genomic annotations and matched samples where the comparison requires them.
routes.acceptance: Preserve genome/strand/feature conventions, biological replication, normalization and multiplicity. Cross-assay joins must retain unmatched features and independently declared linking rules.
routes.limit: Association does not establish epigenetic causality or the molecular basis of disease. A gene-level count table cannot answer isoform/splicing requirements.
routes.relationship: Possible component only; zero complete-source coverage credit.

related_question_pair_review.finding: Both request markers distinguishing diabetes types; no automatic alias or independent-workflow claim.
Both ask about delayed motor-map reorganization after rodent rehabilitation; retain as overlapping requests without automatic alias credit.
Both ask about translation of rodent rehabilitation findings to human protocols; quantitative rodent analysis does not complete either synthesis endpoint.

scope_rules: Harbor only; independently sourced observed data, private input-reading oracles and deterministic complete-artifact verifiers.
Source requests for ideal methods, universal claims, mechanisms and design strategies retain their open synthesis objective. A related numerical task is only a component.
Retain clinical, preclinical and in-vitro endpoints separately. No clinical recommendation follows from a deterministic data-processing task.
Do not copy inspiring papers, benchmark answers or fixtures into training inputs.
All source stems are reviewed; supporting evidence, full acceptance contracts and observed input packages remain unverified.
A component route is a scientific planning link, not a task, source alias, full mapping or implementation commitment.
Prioritize executable ID endpoints in other sources before these open synthesis gaps; do not manufacture narrower tasks to inflate full-coverage counts.
incorrect_output_checks: Wrong units, time window, dose normalization or biological replicate unit must fail when relevant.
Missing hard cases, swapped sample identities and selected-only favorable results must fail.
Evaluation-label leakage and reuse of fitting landmarks as the only registration test must fail.
Reported, recomputed and inferred results must remain distinguishable.
Compositional abundance changes cannot be reported as absolute biomass without independent measurement.
Unassayed editing sites cannot be emitted as verified off-target negatives.
Adsorption, dilution or color loss cannot be graded as proved biodegradation.
Protein/site ambiguity and material geometry normalization must be retained.
Subject/session leakage, trial omissions and changed behavioral success denominators must fail.
Incorrect stimulus alignment, sampling units or electrophysiology baseline windows must fail.
Reused half-maps, wrong voxel orientation or missing failed docking candidates must fail where relevant.
Offline decoding cannot be reported as demonstrated online control or rehabilitation efficacy.
